Roadshow Ambassador APPLY

Role:

Volunteer will be supporting crime prevention roadshows / exhibitions.

 

The volunteers should be able to / be competent to:

1) Able to speak fluently in English and other languages such as Mandarin, Malay, Tamil, or other dialects such as Hokkien, Cantonese, Teochew, etc.

2) Comfortable in talking and engaging the public on crime prevention messages


Volunteering Period:

1) Volunteer will be required to attend a mandatory briefing prior to the roadshow / exhibition

2) Each session is about 4 – 8 hours depending on the roadshow / exhibition

3) Volunteering Period will take place on 2 to 3 May 2026 (Volunteer may select preferred time slot(s), but it is subjected to availability)

4) Location of the roadshow / exhibition is at Keat Hong Community Club

 

Expertise:

1) Volunteer should be comfortable in engaging members of the public


Other Requirements:

1) Candidate will be interviewed, and only successful applicants will be contacted

2) To be conversant in English and other languages such as Mandarin, Malay, Tamil or other dialects such as Hokkien, Cantonese, Teochew, etc.

3) To be able to work independently

Requirements

  • Age Range: 18 to 79 years old
